sentences.text:
Gajendra Behera vs Ratan Kumar Sarangi And Others on 8
October, 2024
 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: M.A.C.A. No.79 of 2007

(In the matter of an appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988)
 Gajendra Behera .... Appellant
 -versus-
 Ratan Kumar Sarangi and others .... Respondents
Appeared in this case by Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode):
 For Appellant - Mr. S. Mohanty,
 Advocate.

For Respondents - Mr. S.K. Mohanty,
 Advocate.
 (For respondent Nos.3 & 4)
 Mr.P.K. Muduli,
 Advocate.
 (For respondent No.2)
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice A.C.Behera
Date of Hearing :03.10.2024 :: Date of Judgment :08.10.2024 A.C. Behera, J.

This appeal under Section 173 of the M.V. Act, 1988 preferred by the appellant (claimant before the learned Tribunal in M.A.C. Case No.11 of 1992) challenging the judgment/award dated 31.10.2006 passed in M.A.C.
Case No.11 of 1992 by the learned 1st M.A.C.T., Keonjhar is taken up for its final disposal at the stage of admission after hearing from the learned counsel for the appellant (claimant/petitioner) and learned counsels for the respondent Nos.2, 3 & 4.
2.

Learned Tribunal has passed the impugned judgment/award in M.A.C. Case No.11 of 1992 in favour of the claimant/petitioner (appellant in this appeal) directing the owners of the offending trucks bearing registration Nos.OR-11-1175 and OR-6883 (opposite party Nos.1 & 2 in that M.A.C.
Case No.11 of 1992) for payment of compensation to the claimant/petitioner in dismissing that M.A.C. Case No.11 of 1992 against the opposite party Nos.3 & 4 (Insurance Companies) on the ground that, as the claimant/petitioner was moving on the offending goods carriage truck as a gratuitous passenger, for which, the opposite party Nos.3 & 4 (Insurance Companies) are not made liable for payment of compensation.

3. Law relating to the fixation of liabilities, when a gratuitous passenger in a goods carriage vehicle (which is covered with statutory insurance policy) sustained injuries has already been clarified by the Hon'ble Courts and Apex Court in the ratio of the following decisions:-
(i) AIR 2017 (S.C.) 1204--Manuara Khatun and Ors.
Gajendra Behera vs Ratan Kumar Sarangi And Others on 8 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180837430/
1

entities.text: Gajendra Behera vs Ratan Kumar Sarangi And Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Vrs. Rajesh Kumar Singh and Ors.--Deceased travelling as gratuitous passenger--Insurer directed to pay amount of compensation to claimants and recover same from insured.
(ii) 2022 Live Law (SC) 932--Balu Krishna Chavan Vrs.
The Reliance General Insurance Co. Ltd. and Ors.-- (Para

12)--In all cases an order for "pay and recover"
would not arise when the Insurance Company is not liable but would, in the facts and circumstances, be considered by this Court to meet the ends of justice, for no other reasons, but for non-prejudicing the claimant, an order for pay and recover can be passed.
( iii )

AIR 2001 (S.C.) 1419--New India Assurance Co., Shimla Vrs. Kamla and others--M.V.Act, 1988-- Insurer made statutorily liable to pay compensation to third parties can recover from insured vehicle owner, amount paid to third parties.

entities.text: AIR 2001 (S.C.) 1419--New India Assurance Co., Shimla Vrs. Kamla and others--M.V.Act, 1988
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
(iv) AIRONLINE 2023 CAL 1383--Sulakha Pandit Vrs. National Insurance Company Ltd.--(Paras 9 & 12)--
Motor Vehicles Act, 1988--Sections 168 & 147-- Compensation--Liability of Insurance Company--Claimant was gratuitous passenger of offending vehicle--Insurance Company may be directed to pay compensation at first instance, when it is found that, insurance policy was valid on date of accident and liberty can be granted to recover amount from owner of offending vehicle in accordance with law--Accordingly, award was modified.

entities.text: -Sulakha Pandit Vrs. National Insurance Company Ltd.--(Paras 9 & 12)--
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: When, the involved offending trucks bearing registration Nos. OR- 11-1175 and OR-6883 r e s p e c t i v e l y i n t h e m o t o r v e h i c u l a r a c c i d e n t ( t h r o u g h t h e u s e o f w h i c h , t h e claimant/petitioner/appellant sustained injuries at the time of the accident) were covered with statutory insurance policies, then in view of the propositions of law enunciated in the ratio of the aforesaid decisions, it was the duty of the learned Tribunal to direct the opposite party Nos.3 & 4 (Insurance Companies) of M.A.C. Case No.11 of 1992 to pay the awarded compensation amount with interest first to the petitioner, then to recover the said paid awarded compensation amount with interest from the owners of the offending trucks i.e. opposite party Nos.1 & 2, but the learned Tribunal has not done so.
For which, there is justification under law for making interference with the same, through this appeal preferred by the appellant (petitioner/claimant).
Therefore, there is some merit in the appeal of the appellant (claimant).
The same is to be allowed in part.
4. In result, the appeal preferred by the appellant (claimant) is allowed in part on contest against the respondents.

The directions given in the impugned award/judgment passed on dated 31.10.2006 in M.A.C. Case No.11 of 1992 directing the opposite party Nos.1 & 2 (respondent Nos.1 & 2 in this appeal) for payment of the awarded compensation amount to the petitioner in dismissing the case against the Gajendra Behera vs Ratan Kumar Sarangi And Others on 8 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180837430/
2 opposite party Nos.3 & 4 (Insurance Companies) are altered/modified as follows.
The awarded amount with interest thereon passed on dated 31.10.2006 in M.A.C. Case No.11 of 1992 by the learned 1st M.A.C.T., Keonjhar shall be paid by the opposite party Nos.3 & 4 (Insurance Companies) first to the petitioner, then to recover the said amount with interest thereon from the owners of the offending trucks bearing registration No.OR-11-1175 and OR-6883 (opposite party Nos.1 & 2) as per law.
5.

entities.text: Gajendra Behera vs Ratan Kumar Sarangi And Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As such, with the aforesaid modifications/alterations of the impugned award, the appeal is disposed of finally.

Registry is directed to transmit the copy of this judgment to the learned Tribunal in reference to M.A.C. Case No.11 of 1992 for early payment of the awarded compensation amount with interest thereon to the petitioner thereof.

(A.C. Behera), Judge.
Orissa High Court, Cuttack.
